podcast.title: Composed of Former Moon Dogs Members
podcast.body: The band was assembled by Phil Specter from members of The Moon Dogs, a band Marshall Leib (Specter's best friend) had been in previously. Members included guitarist Elliott Ingber, bass player Larry Taylor, keyboard player Howard Hirsch, and drummer Rudd Schaefer. Kim Fowley, observing their single performance, noted some of these musicians for future collaborations. "Spectre wanted a band to play a gig to promote that single, and he put together the Phil Harvey band from the members of another band that Marshall Leib had been in before joining the teddy bears."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: One-Gig Band Concept
podcast.body: Formed by Phil Specter (under the pseudonym Phil Harvey) to promote his solo instrumental single, this band played only one gig. Its concept was a unique mix of Dwayne Eddy's style rock guitar instrumentals and complex jazz, with the members all dressed as mobsters. "The band's concept was apparently a mix of Dwayne Eddy's style rock guitar instrumentals and complex jazz, with the group All Dressed As mobsters."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
